title: The impact of APC mutation on the efficacy of anti-EGFR therapy in metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS wild type: a retrospective analysis.
caption: Kaplan–Meier curves of progression-free survival and overall survival in patients without hepatic metastasis.
context: Kaplan–Meier curves of progression-free survival and overall survival in patients without hepatic metastasis. For overall survival, no deaths were observed in the APC-mutant group, consequently showing significant difference between the groups ( p = 0.00088; Figure 4 ).
